title: RWB-S6-E5023-APP: the eligibility slice has no plan row for its four consumed contracts, its outbox library, its rule kit, the 54 percent cap criterion or the two eligibility inputs
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E5023-APP; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E5-023; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.1, A2.16, A1.3, A1.4 and Requirements served; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1 to T3.3, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-01, R-DS-02, R-DS-03 and R-DS-19; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-DBS-01 and FEAT-DBS-16
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E5023-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case case list, the rwb-source-data COLLINS score product and the rwb-decision package and answers the rwb-case case move, so four consumed rows have no plan row. (2) The service owns topic rwb.debtsale.events.v1 with event EV-23, yet DP-09 is absent from the pattern set of this key, so the outbox and inbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row. (3) DP-04 is absent although the step evaluates the DEBTSALE route set of 41 rules over 29 states, so no Drools kit row RWB-PLT-E1072-CON or C row RWB-P7-E1073-CON is held. (4) Legacy AC1 names the 54 percent cap, but no row of R-DS-01 to R-DS-03 tests it: the only cap row of the route set is R-DS-19 at BIDS_RECEIVED, and the cap has its own feature FEAT-DBS-16 in E6. (5) R-DS-01 and R-DS-02 test deviation_open and fraud_flag, which appear in no field list of TSD S6 T3.1 and no Data table of the legacy story. (6) The legacy Data table names recovery_case, decision_log_entry and rule_row, none of which this service may read or write, and the legacy endpoints carry the monolith base /api/recovery/v1. (7) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S6-E5023-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04, DP-05 and DP-09 rows; context pack ownership rows (debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account, S6; 5 REST operations; event EV-23; workflow DebtSaleWorkflow); FSD S6 A2.1.3.1 and A2.16; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-01, R-DS-02, R-DS-03 and R-DS-19; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 FEAT-DBS-01 and FEAT-DBS-16; legacy RWB-E5-023 Data, Endpoints, Acceptance criteria and Guardrails
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; record the rwb-case, rwb-source-data and rwb-decision rows as class C in fact with their placeholders; record RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as the wave 0 library the service's topic needs and RWB-PLT-E1072-CON with RWB-P7-E1073-CON as the rule kit the evaluation needs; read the cap value from the package, leave the cap test and FEAT-DBS-16 with RWB-S6-E6005-APP; declare deviation_open and fraud_flag as consumed rule inputs with a placeholder; adopt REQ-S6-001 for traceability

title: RWB-S6-E5023-CON: the consumed operation names, the case boundary element, the event names and the field-level types of the two lot operations have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E5023-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale; legacy RWB-E5-023; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.1.2, A2.1.3.1, A2.1.4.4 and Screens; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-01, R-DS-02 and R-DS-03
description: (1) The rwb-source-data data-product catalogue names the COLLINS score but publishes no operation name, so the consumed row carries a placeholder. (2) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage; the S6 row of the connection matrix names Temporal to P7 and listens to nothing but sends events to the shared capabilities, so the case move is declared as the child workflow's stage outcome and any REST case-move operation carries a placeholder. (3) The event set of the topic is named in the architecture, not in an AsyncAPI catalogue, so LotAwarded (EV-23) and AccountsTransferred are named from the service's event list and declared as the later stories'. (4) TSD S6 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (5) TSD S6 T3.1 gives the physical types of the two tables but publishes no OpenAPI element, so the element names, required flags and field-level formats are fixed by this baseline, not copied from a source. (6) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares four consumed rows.
evidence: TSD S6 T-A.1 operations API-S6-001 to API-S6-005 and T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids; TSD S6 T3.1 field list; context pack connection-matrix row S6 (Temporal to P7, Temporal and event to P5 and P8, Temporal to P2); FSD S6 A2.1.4.4 (no background event); legacy RWB-E5-023 messages MSG-S6-001, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the case boundary as the child workflow's input, signals and stage outcome, confirm the three operation names with their owners before the tag, and record the tag date in the contract README
